item.title: Feds, Ontario pool $8.8B for housing infrastructure to cut development fees
item.description: OTTAWA — The federal and Ontario governments said Monday they will together invest billions of dollars in local infrastructure spending to help cities cut costly development fees and get more homes built.

item.title: Drivers urged to avoid flooded roads as severe storms expected overnight
item.description: Emergency officials are reminding people to take cover if threatening weather approaches after Environment Canada issued a severe thunderstorm watch for multiple communities where lightning activity and heavy rain are expected overnight

item.title: Canada not worried U.S.-Mexico trade talks will upend trilateral deal, LeBlanc says
item.description: OTTAWA — Canada-U.S. Trade Minister Dominic LeBlanc said on Monday he isn't worried Mexico will sign a trade agreement with the Americans that excludes Canada.

item.title: Israel's parliament approves the death penalty for Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis
item.description: JERUSALEM (AP) — Israel’s parliament on Monday passed a law approving the death penalty for Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis, a measure that has been harshly condemned by the international community and rights groups as discriminatory and

item.title: Hate crimes numbers stayed steady in 2024 after years of increases: StatCan
item.description: OTTAWA — The number of police-reported hate crimes stayed steady in 2024, after sharp increases in prior years, Statistics Canada said Monday.

item.title: Ottawa launches consultation on national anti-fraud strategy
item.description: The federal government says it will be consulting for the next four weeks on a national strategy to tackle financial scams targeting Canadians and businesses.

item.title: B.C. youth charged over alleged school shooting threats in chats with U.S. teen
item.description: SOOKE — Police on Vancouver Island say a youth who lives in Sooke, B.C., has been charged after allegedly making threats about a school shooting in online chats with a 15-year-old in the United States.

item.title: Summer air quality alerts will become routine in U.S. without action: UWaterloo study
item.description: A new study out of the University of Waterloo is underlining how North American air quality could deteriorate by the end of the century unless efforts are taken to fight climate change.

item.title: Lawyers to begin final submissions in Frank Stronach sex assault trial
item.description: TORONTO — Lawyers are set to begin their final submissions today in the sexual assault trial of Canadian auto parts tycoon Frank Stronach.

item.title: Ottawa extending 2% alcohol tax hike cap for another 2 years
item.description: OTTAWA — The federal government is set to extend its cap on an annual alcohol tax increase for another two years in a bid to rein in costs facing Canada's brewers, wineries and distilleries.
